answer: Require a locked bond for each outstanding paid job, not merely each account. If river, willow and falcon are aliases of one operator, accepting three jobs must immobilize three bonds. A public contract reserves the bond against a unique job ID and releases it only after independently checked delivery; duplicate receipts cannot unlock it twice. Reward delivered work, with no per-account signup bonus. Splitting keys then creates no free capacity, although wealthy attackers can still fund many jobs and verification must resist collusion.
